manifest.name: dsh-pwsh-guard
manifest.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: reject shell text I/O - Select-String, Get-Content, findstr, rg, cat, node -e - in pwsh/bash/ops_bash, and point the agent at read/grep/glob.
manifest.author: Steven-Qiang <git@qiangmou.ren>

bundle.text:
- insert:
    - id: pwsh-guard
      name: 'dsh-pwsh-guard'
      config:
        enabled: true
        tools:
          - pwsh
          - bash
          - ops_bash
        disabledGroups: []
        allowPatterns: []

readme.text:
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-pwsh-guard)
[](https://github.com/Steven-Qiang/dsh-pwsh-guard/actions/workflows/release.yml)
[](LICENSE)

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that enforces one rule: **read files with `read`, search with `grep`,
locate files with `glob`** — not with shell text commands.

It registers a `ctx.tools.guard` over `pwsh`, `bash` and `ops_bash`. A call whose command line
performs file text I/O is rejected before execution, and the rejection reason names the tool to use
instead. Rejection messages follow the host locale (English or Chinese).

| id | group | blocks | use instead |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `search.Select-String`, `search.sls` | textSearch | `Select-String`, `sls` | `grep` |
| `search.findstr`, `search.grep`, `search.rg` | textSearch | `findstr`, `grep`, `rg` | `grep` |
| `read.Get-Content`, `read.gc`, `read.cat`, `read.type` | textRead | `Get-Content` and its aliases | `read` |
| `read.more`, `read.head`, `read.tail` | textRead | `more`, `head`, `tail` | `read` |
| `bypass.node-eval`, `bypass.python-c`, `bypass.php-r`, `bypass.dotnet-io` | runtimeBypass | `node -e`, `python -c`, `php -r`, `[IO.File]::ReadAllText` that read files | `read`, `grep` |
| `wait.Start-Sleep`, `wait.sleep` | sleep | `Start-Sleep`, `sleep` | probe the port, read the job again later, `schedule_create` |
| `pipeline.stderr-merge` | stderrMerge | `2>&1` followed by a pipe | `$LASTEXITCODE`, `2>err.txt` |
| `job.wait` | jobWait | `job_output` called with `wait: true` | probe the port (`Test-NetConnection`, `curl`), or read the job again later |

Two matching rules keep false positives down:

- Short aliases match in command position only (`^`, `;`, `|`, `&`, `(`, `{`, `$(`), so
  `Get-ChildItem -Type f`, `git gc` and `git log --grep=x` pass.
- Quoted spans are ignored, so `git commit -m "stop using Select-String"` passes. Rules that inspect
  a script body (`node -e ...`) read the raw string.

All fields are optional.

```yaml
- id: pwsh-guard
  name: 'dsh-pwsh-guard'
  config:
    enabled: true

`language: auto` follows `DSH_LOCALE`, then the host locale, then `LANG` / `LC_ALL`.

```yaml
    rules:
      - id: no-force-push
        pattern: 'git\s+push\s+--force'
        title: 'Force push is blocked'

From npm:

```
plugin_manager action: install_bundle target: dsh-pwsh-guard
```

From GitHub:

```
plugin_manager action: install_bundle target: https://github.com/Steven-Qiang/dsh-pwsh-guard
```

From a local checkout (`link:`, for development):

```
git clone https://github.com/Steven-Qiang/dsh-pwsh-guard
plugin_manager action: install_bundle target: /path/to/dsh-pwsh-guard
```

After editing code or config, reload without restarting:

```
plugin_manager action: set_plugin target: include:pwsh-guard enabled: false
plugin_manager action: set_plugin target: include:pwsh-guard enabled: true
```

Uninstall: `plugin_manager action: remove_bundle target: dsh-pwsh-guard`.

If `install_bundle` reports `failedAt: registry`, the failure came from another dependency of the
profile; the package link, `package.json` entry and `cordis.yml` row are usually already written.
Check for `node_modules/dsh-pwsh-guard/index.js` and the `id: pwsh-guard` row before retrying.

- Command names inside quotes (`& "Select-String"`, `powershell -Command "Get-Content x"`) are not detected.
- `-EncodedCommand` is not decoded.
- `ops_bash --script_path` is checked by path only, not by script content.
- Directory listing (`Get-ChildItem`, `ls`, `dir`) is out of scope.
- Not a sandbox. For destructive commands and secret access use a dedicated guard such as
  `cc-safety-net`; its rule schema cannot express "deny every use of this command", which is why
  this plugin exists.

```
npm test
```

Builds with tsdown, then runs 36 command fixtures and 11 configuration assertions.

Versions are owned by CI — do not edit `version`. Pushing to `main` runs
`.github/workflows/release.yml`:

| commits | bump |
| --- | --- |
| `fix:` | patch |
| `feat:` | minor |
| `feat!:` or `BREAKING CHANGE:` | major |
| anything else | no release |

Publishing uses npm Trusted Publishing over OIDC, so no `NPM_TOKEN` is stored. It requires
`permissions.id-token: write` (configured), Node ≥ 22.14 with npm CLI ≥ 11.5.1 (the workflow uses
Node 24 plus `npm install -g npm@latest`), and a `repository.url` that matches this repository.

The Trusted Publisher is configured on npmjs.com for `Steven-Qiang` / `dsh-pwsh-guard` /
`release.yml`. A new package has to be published manually once before that configuration exists,
and a new Trusted Publisher must complete a successful publish within 2 days or it expires.

[English](README.md) | **简体中文**

DeepSeek Harness 插件，把一条约定变成硬约束：**读文件用 `read`、搜内容用 `grep`、找文件用 `glob`**，
不要用 shell 文本命令。

插件用 `ctx.tools.guard` 注册全局守卫，覆盖 `pwsh`、`bash`、`ops_bash`。命令一旦在用 shell 做文件
文本 I/O，就会在执行前被拒绝，拒绝原因里写明该换哪个工具。拒绝文案跟随宿主语言（中文或英文）。

| id | 分组 | 拦截 | 改用 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `search.Select-String`、`search.sls` | textSearch | `Select-String`、`sls` | `grep` |
| `search.findstr`、`search.grep`、`search.rg` | textSearch | `findstr`、`grep`、`rg` | `grep` |
| `read.Get-Content`、`read.gc`、`read.cat`、`read.type` | textRead | `Get-Content` 及其别名 | `read` |
| `read.more`、`read.head`、`read.tail` | textRead | `more`、`head`、`tail` | `read` |
| `bypass.node-eval`、`bypass.python-c`、`bypass.php-r`、`bypass.dotnet-io` | runtimeBypass | 脚本里读文件的 `node -e`、`python -c`、`php -r`、`[IO.File]::ReadAllText` | `read`、`grep` |
| `wait.Start-Sleep`、`wait.sleep` | sleep | `Start-Sleep`、`sleep` | 探测端口、过一会儿再读任务、`schedule_create` |
| `pipeline.stderr-merge` | stderrMerge | `2>&1` 之后又接管道 | `$LASTEXITCODE`、`2>err.txt` |
| `job.wait` | jobWait | `job_output` 传 `wait: true` | 探测端口（`Test-NetConnection`、`curl`），或过一会儿再读任务 |

两条判定规则用来压低误报：

- **短别名只在命令位置判定**（`^`、`;`、`|`、`&`、`(`、`{`、`$(`），所以 `Get-ChildItem -Type f`、
  `git gc`、`git log --grep=x` 都会放行。
- **引号内的文字不参与判定**，所以 `git commit -m "stop using Select-String"` 会放行；检查脚本内容
  的规则（`node -e ...`）看原文。

所有字段都可省略。

```yaml
- id: pwsh-guard
  name: 'dsh-pwsh-guard'
  config:
    enabled: true

`language: auto` 依次看 `DSH_LOCALE`、宿主 locale、`LANG` / `LC_ALL`。

```yaml
    rules:
      - id: no-force-push
        pattern: 'git\s+push\s+--force'
        title: '禁止强推'

从 npm：

```
plugin_manager action: install_bundle target: dsh-pwsh-guard
```

从 GitHub：

```
plugin_manager action: install_bundle target: https://github.com/Steven-Qiang/dsh-pwsh-guard
```

从本地 clone（`link:` 安装，方便改代码）：

```
git clone https://github.com/Steven-Qiang/dsh-pwsh-guard
plugin_manager action: install_bundle target: /path/to/dsh-pwsh-guard
```

改完代码或配置，重载即可，不用重启：

```
plugin_manager action: set_plugin target: include:pwsh-guard enabled: false
plugin_manager action: set_plugin target: include:pwsh-guard enabled: true
```

卸载：`plugin_manager action: remove_bundle target: dsh-pwsh-guard`。

如果 `install_bundle` 报 `failedAt: registry`，失败来自 profile 里别的依赖；此时包链接、
`package.json` 条目和 `cordis.yml` 里的行通常已经写好了。重试前先确认
`node_modules/dsh-pwsh-guard/index.js` 与 `id: pwsh-guard` 那一行是否存在。

- 引号包住的命令名（`& "Select-String"`、`powershell -Command "Get-Content x"`）检测不到。
- `-EncodedCommand` 不解码。
- `ops_bash --script_path` 只看路径，不看脚本体。
- 目录列举（`Get-ChildItem`、`ls`、`dir`）不在管辖范围。
- 不是沙箱。防破坏性命令与密钥访问请另配专门的 guard（例如 `cc-safety-net`）；它的规则模型
  表达不了「任何一次使用都拦」，所以才有这个插件。

```
npm test
```

版本由 CI 决定，不要手改 `version`。推送到 `main` 会跑 `.github/workflows/release.yml`：
